note: Knowledge-point layer (Math Academy Way, scaffolded mastery learning). A first scaffold: each skill is decomposed into introduce -> practice -> transfer KPs recast from its OWN teachingMove / check / transfer — no KP text is invented. Each KP proposes the KEY PREREQUISITE it most directly uses (introduce -> most foundational prerequisite, practice/transfer -> most proximate), marked pending-expert. Deeper per-skill decomposition (more advanced-case KPs) and confirmed key prerequisites are the educator audit’s job. The key-prerequisite link is the hook for MA-style targeted remediation: fail a KP twice -> remedial review of its key prerequisite.
